user.title: Dyson Lightcycle Morph
user.description: Configure your Dyson lamp via BLE. You need the lamp serial/BLE address, your Dyson cloud user id and the LTK (Long Term Key) in hex.

data.address: BLE address (UUID on macOS, MAC on Linux) - leave empty to auto-scan by serial

error.cannot_connect: [dyson_lamp v0.2.5] Could not connect to the lamp. Check the address (must be a MAC on Linux/HA, or empty for auto-scan), user id and LTK.
error.auth_failed: [dyson_lamp v0.2.5] Connected, but authentication failed. Check the user id and LTK.
error.mac_uuid: [dyson_lamp v0.2.5] This looks like a macOS CoreBluetooth UUID. On Linux/HA enter the lamp's MAC address (e.g. A4:C1:38:AA:BB:CC) or leave the address empty to auto-scan by serial.
error.no_address: [dyson_lamp v0.2.5] Provide either a BLE address (MAC) or a serial number.
error.unknown: [dyson_lamp v0.2.5] Unexpected error. See Home Assistant log.

init.title: Dyson Lightcycle Morph options
init.description: Choose how the BLE connection to the lamp should behave.
